run_inference_on_image: run the inference script with a checkpoint and input image to get ImageNet predictions
run_adversarial_model_with_depth: run the inference script with a specific ResNet depth of 50, 101, or 152
run_custom_architecture_inference: run the inference script with a custom architecture name from nets.py
review_model_get_logits: review the model get_logits method used to build the TensorFlow inference graph
summarize_inference_pipeline: summarize the inference pipeline that loads checkpoints, preprocesses images, and predicts top-5 classes
